err.file.wiffNoSource: file verify called with fewer than two .wiff/.wiff.scan pairs (the file under test and at least one source). No parameters.
err.file.wiffGrowing: {name} = the member of the pair that changed size (.wiff or .wiff.scan); {from} and {to} = its size in bytes at the two readings; {ms} = milliseconds between the readings.
err.file.wiffTruncated: {name} = name of the .wiff file; {size} = file size in bytes; {needed} = bytes required by the file's sector table.
err.file.cutShort: Truncated vendor file (interrupted copy). {name} = file name; {size} = file size in bytes; {needed} = bytes required by the file's internal table.
err.file.functionsCut: Waters .raw folder whose function list is truncated (interrupted copy). {name} = folder name; {listed} = functions the list contains.
err.file.indexCut: Waters .raw folder with a truncated or damaged function index (interrupted copy). {name} = folder name; {file} = index file (_FUNCnnn.IDX).
err.file.folderIncomplete: Waters .raw folder without _FUNCTNS.INF (incomplete copy). {name} = folder name; {file} = missing file.
err.file.folderDamaged: No placeholder in the text. The error carries {detail} (which record word or which range does not add up, in English from the reader): the CLI writes it in parentheses after the key, the page does not. It can arrive when opening or reading a scan.
err.file.folderFileCut: Waters .raw folder with _FUNCTNS.INF cut in the middle of a record. {name} = folder name; {file} = truncated file.
err.file.functionsEmpty: Waters .raw folder with an empty _FUNCTNS.INF (interrupted copy). {name} = folder name.
err.file.recordVariant: Waters .raw folder whose only function with data uses a record width that is not yet decoded. {name} = folder name; {function} = function number; {type} = function type byte in hexadecimal (e.g. 0x10).
err.file.headerCut: Waters .raw folder with a truncated _HEADER.TXT (interrupted copy). {name} = folder name; {file} = header file name.
err.file.index: {detail} = technical reason (English text from the engine).
err.file.mzmlInvalid: {detail} = first problem the validator found in the mzML just written (English text from the engine).
err.file.moduleLoad: {family} = family of the reader that failed to load (agilent, thermo, sciex, ...); the page loads it from wasm-lettori/.
err.file.wiff: No placeholder in the text. The error carries {detail} (the part of the .wiff that does not add up, in English from the reader): the CLI writes it in parentheses after the key, the page does not.
err.file.wiffScanType: A .wiff sample with a scan type the engine does not read (e.g. MS3, code 13): specific message, not the bare code. {type} = type abbreviation (mode table: MS3, TOF MS, ...), {code} = numeric code, {experiment} = experiment number (from 1).
err.file.wiffPeriods: {periods} = number of periods in the method.
err.file.wiffMassRange: {experiment} = experiment number in the method (from 1); {expected} = entries announced by the header; {detail} = technical cause in English.
err.file.shimadzu: {detail} = technical reason (English text from the reader).
err.file.unknown: {detail} = technical reason (English text from the engine).
err.file.read: A read of the source file (mzML or vendor file) that failed or was truncated; {offset} = start byte, {length} = bytes requested. It is not the index: that stays error.badIndex.
err.file.raw: {detail} = technical reason (English text from the library).
err.file.empty: A file with the extension of a known format but 0 bytes long; {name} = file name.
err.file.notThisFormat: A file with the extension of a format that no reader recognizes from the start (truncated or damaged copy); {name} = file name, {size} = file size in bytes, {ext} = extension (.mzxml, .cdf, .qgd, ...).
err.file.rawTruncated: {stage} = structure of the Thermo .raw that the file does not contain in full; {size} = file size in bytes; {needed} = bytes up to which the file is needed; {readable} = whole scans that can be read; {declared} = scans declared.
err.file.rawDamaged: No placeholder in the text. The error carries {detail} (the reader's error, in English) and, when known, {stage} (the file structure that does not add up): the CLI writes them in parentheses after the key, the page does not.
err.file.rawUnfinished: No placeholder in the text. The error carries {detail} (what is missing, in English from the reader: no controller, the run header declares no scan) and {size} (file size in bytes): the CLI writes them in parentheses after the key, the page does not.
err.file.rawVersion: {version} = version number of the Thermo .raw format read from the header.
err.file.notAgilentDList: {name} = name of the .D folder. {count} = number of files received for it. {found} = comma-separated list of the received files with their paths inside the folder and sizes, e.g. data.ms (2.0 MB), AcqData/Contents.xml (1.2 kB), at most 30 entries.
err.file.agilentCalibration: {scan} = scan number (ScanID) without its record in AcqData/MSMassCal.bin.
err.file.brukerCalibration: {frame} = frame number (Frames.Id) that has no usable MzCalibration row.
err.file.brukerNoBin: {name} = name of the .d folder; {file} = the missing file (analysis.tdf_bin or analysis.tsf_bin).
err.file.nativeStopped: The engine worker was lost (or returned text without a key) while reading a vendor file. {name} = name of the file or .d folder; {detail} = error text, «–» if there is none.
err.file.nativeStopped.native: The command line and the app variant of the previous key. {name} = name of the file or .d folder; {detail} = error text.
err.file.alreadyMzml: A file given to convert or to the sample list is an mzML already, so there is nothing to convert. {name} = file name.
err.file.cdfDamaged: No placeholder in the text. The error carries {detail} (which part of the header does not add up, in English from the reader): the CLI writes it in parentheses after the key, the page does not.
err.file.removedElsewhere: {name} = name of the file removed in another tab or window.
warn.file.mzmlFewer: Calm partial-read warning from the mzML engine (Run.losses): the file closes but the spectrumList count is higher than the spectra present.
warn.file.truncated: Calm partial-read warning (conversion/1.loss, CLI): the file is cut off, the declared scans beyond the end are missing.
warn.file.damaged: Calm partial-read warning (CLI, stream): some spectra have damaged data, they are left out without points and counted; the rest of the file is read.
warn.file.brukerCutBin: Calm partial-read warning (conversion/1.loss, CLI) for a .d folder: the *_bin file is cut off, the spectra of the frames beyond the end are missing.
warn.file.memberMissing: Calm partial-read warning (conversion/1.loss, CLI): a data member of a folder is missing (Waters _FUNCnnn.DAT), its scans are missing.
warn.file.recordWidth: Calm partial-read warning (conversion/1.loss, CLI): record of an undecoded size, the scans of that function are missing.
err.file.brukerDamaged: No placeholder in the text. The error carries {detail} (the SQLite table or the block of the _bin file that does not add up, in English from the reader): the CLI writes it in parentheses after the key, the page does not.
err.file.agilent: No placeholder in the text. The error carries {detail} (the file of the .D folder that does not add up, in English from the reader): the CLI writes it in parentheses after the key, the page does not.
err.file.agilentCut: Agilent .D folder copied halfway: no whole scan is left to read. {name} = name of the .D folder.
err.file.agilentNoPeaks: Agilent .D folder with the scan list but without the MSPeak.bin spectra file (missing or empty). {name} = name of the .D folder.
err.file.agilentIms: Ion mobility (IMS) .D folder (Agilent, frames split into drift bins): format not yet read, no data loaded.
err.file.nonFinite: Reader error message; {scan} = scan id or number, {what} = rt, tic, mz or intensity, {value} = NaN, inf or -inf.
err.file.nonFiniteTrace: Reader error message; {trace} = chromatogram id, {what} = time or intensity, {value} = NaN, inf or -inf.
err.file.mzmlPrecision: mzML engine error message; {scan} = id or number of the scan or chromatogram.
err.file.mzmlLengths: mzML engine error message; {scan} = id or number; {a} and {b} = lengths of the two arrays (m/z and intensity, or time and intensity).
err.file.mzmlNoItems: mzML engine error message; {count} = spectra and chromatograms declared by the file's lists.
err.pack.manifest: {detail} = what is wrong with the pack manifest (not JSON, wrong schema, inconsistent offsets, bad hash).
err.pack.path: {path} = the path of the manifest or of the input that is not a plain relative name.
err.pack.duplicate: {path} = the second of two input or manifest paths that clash (equal, equal in lower case, or a file named like a folder of the other); {other} = the first.
err.pack.exists: {path} = the first existing file or part; {count} = how many already exist.
err.pack.growing: {path} = the input whose size changed while it was read.
